plan.failureSummary: Cached Page.AI replay failed to locate the 'Last Name' field because the survey form structure changed on the live page.
observedIndicators: Error stack trace directly points to the cached replay file in .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js
Failure screenshot reveals modified form fields ('Your Name', 'Contact Email', 'Occupation') that contradict cached selectors looking for 'Last Name *'
Deterministic mode was used on the initial run attempt without prior retry
Flow history shows alternating successful runs and deterministic failures consistent with periodic dynamic form variations handled via cache regeneration

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry test
remediationSteps.details: Delete or invalidate the cached entry in .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js and re-run the test to allow Page.AI to inspect the current form layout and regenerate valid actions.

remediationSteps.summary: Review survey schema and instructions if retry fails
remediationSteps.details: If the autonomous run fails against the updated form, verify that the schema and survey completion flow align with the application state.

plan.notes: The failure occurred inside the generated .cache.js replay script. The live screenshot shows new form fields ('Your Name', 'Contact Email', 'Occupation') replacing the previous structure ('Last Name', 'Email Address', age radio buttons). The high-level objective is flexible and clearing the cache will allow Page.AI to autonomously complete the survey.
